Overview

Kuressaare is a city in Saare County with a population of 13,000. The capital of Saaremaa island, a charming resort town with a stunning medieval bishop’s castle, a beautiful seaside promenade, and a peaceful island atmosphere. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
